# EMPLOYMENT OFFER LETTER
## Senior Software Engineer

[Company Letterhead]

Date: [DATE]

[Candidate Name]
[Address]
[City, State ZIP]

Dear [Candidate Name],

We are pleased to extend an offer of employment for the position of **Senior Software Engineer** at [Company Name]. We were impressed with your technical expertise, engineering leadership, and collaborative approach, and we believe you will be a valuable addition to our engineering team.

## Position Details

| Item | Details |
|------|---------|
| **Title** | Senior Software Engineer |
| **Department** | Engineering |
| **Reports To** | [Engineering Manager Name / VP of Engineering] |
| **Location** | [Office Location / Remote / Hybrid] |
| **Start Date** | [Proposed Start Date] |
| **Employment Type** | Full-Time, Exempt |
| **Work Schedule** | [Standard core hours, e.g., 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM local time, with flexible scheduling] |

## Core Responsibilities

In this role, you will be expected to:

- Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable software solutions using [primary tech stack, e.g., Java/TypeScript/React] in our [product/platform] environment
- Lead technical design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions
- Mentor and guide junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews and pairing
- Collaborate with product management and cross-functional teams to translate requirements into technical solutions
- Champion code quality, testing, observability, and engineering best practices
- Participate in on-call rotation and incident response as required

## Compensation

**Base Salary:** $[AMOUNT] per year, paid [bi-weekly/semi-monthly], subject to applicable withholdings and deductions.

**Performance Bonus:** Eligible for an annual discretionary bonus of up to [X]% of base salary, based on company and individual performance. Bonus eligibility requires active employment on the payment date and is subject to Company policy.

**Equity:** Subject to approval by the Board of Directors and the terms of the Company's [Equity Incentive Plan], you will be granted [X] [stock options / restricted stock units] vesting over 4 years with a 1-year cliff, as described in a separate equity agreement to be provided.

**Sign-On Bonus (if applicable):** [One-time sign-on bonus of $[AMOUNT], paid within the first [30] days of employment / Not applicable].

## Benefits

You will be eligible for our standard benefits package, effective [date], including:

- Health, dental, and vision insurance
- 401(k) with [X]% company match
- [X] days paid time off (PTO) per year
- [X] paid holidays
- [X] days sick leave
- Professional development budget of $[X] per year
- Home office / remote work stipend of $[X] (if applicable)
- [Other benefits, e.g., life insurance, disability coverage, wellness stipend]

Full details will be provided during onboarding.

## Contingencies

This offer is contingent upon:

- Successful completion of a background check and reference verification
- Verification of your right to work in [Country] (permanent residency or work authorization)
- Execution of required employment documents, including:
  - Confidentiality / NDA Agreement
  - Intellectual Property Assignment Agreement
  - [Non-Compete Agreement, if applicable and permissible in your jurisdiction]
  - Employee Handbook acknowledgment

## At-Will Employment

Please note that employment with [Company Name] is **at-will**. This means that either you or the Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice. This offer letter does not constitute a contract of employment for any specific duration, and no statement in this letter creates a contractual obligation for future employment.

## Acceptance

To accept this offer, please sign below and return this letter by [DEADLINE DATE] to [HR Contact email]. This offer will expire if not accepted by that date.

We are excited about the possibility of you joining our team. If you have any questions about the terms above or the onboarding process, please contact [HR Contact] at [email/phone].

Sincerely,

_________________________
[Hiring Manager Name]
[Title]
[Company Name]

---

## ACCEPTANCE

I accept this offer of employment for the position of Senior Software Engineer and agree to the terms stated above.

Signature: _________________________

Printed Name: _________________________

Date: _________________________

Anticipated Start Date: _________________________

---

**Notes for use:**
- Replace all bracketed `[placeholders]` with your specific details (salary, equity grant, tech stack, dates, and contacts).
- The IP Assignment and Confidentiality clauses are especially important for engineering roles — ensure they are executed before the start date.
- Non-compete enforceability varies significantly by jurisdiction; consult local counsel before including one.
- Per the employment-contract-templates skill: these templates are for informational purposes only and do not constitute legal advice. Have qualified legal counsel review before use.
